# Shared repository instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root before working.
It defines the required independent cross-vendor review and consensus workflow for
implementation, code review and Spec Kit analyses, including model selection and
access verification. These are shared project instructions, not a separate policy.

When assigned as the independent reviewer, inspect the exact supplied revision and
evidence, remain read-only, and return findings and an explicit verdict to the lead.
Do not launch another reviewer. A Copilot product name does not establish the model
vendor; verify the explicitly selected model and reasoning setting for the session.
